comment: Independent seed 6630218 (debug mode). The Valkyrie unlocks and opens the room's south door, steps into the open doorway and digs down with a wished pick-axe. dig.c dighole() makes a pit there through trap.c maketrap(), whose `lev->flags = 0` also clears the rm.h doormask alias, leaving D_NODOOR. After climbing out, the hero therefore moves diagonally out of the doorway (hack.c test_move()), which an intact open door would refuse.
